posts.videoTitle: $1,500 of groceries a year goes in the trash
posts.text:
The average household throws out about $1,500 of groceries a year. That's about $29 a week, or $4 a day.

The cheapest fix is the boring one: cook what's already in the fridge before the next grocery run. iEatz builds recipes from what you have.

#foodwaste #budgetmeals #mealplanning #savemoney #ieatzhealthy
